title: THE OCEAN IS MORE TERRIFYING THAN YOU THINK

scenes.name: The Unknown
scenes.narration: The ocean looks peaceful from above. But beneath the surface lies a world we barely understand.

scenes.name: Eternal Darkness
scenes.narration: At around 1,000 metres deep, sunlight is gone. No sunrise. No moonlight. Just permanent darkness.

scenes.name: Crushing Pressure
scenes.narration: In the deepest ocean trenches, pressure exceeds a thousand times what we experience at the surface.

scenes.name: Creatures in the Darkness
scenes.narration: Some creatures generate their own light. And some use that light to lure unsuspecting prey towards their mouths.

scenes.name: Giants Below
scenes.narration: Giant squid are real. They inhabit deep waters where humans have rarely observed them alive.

scenes.name: What Haven't We Seen?
scenes.narration: Scientists have visually explored only a tiny fraction of the deep seafloor. The terrifying part? We still have so much left to discover.
